# environment-variables commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `export` | Export environment variables for deployment settings |
| `get` | Get environment variable details |
| `list` | List environment variables |
| `set` | Set an environment variable value |
| `url` | Get the Maker portal URL for an environment variable |
